remarks: Location, location, location! Walk to shops, restaurants, and parks from this freshly painted, light-filled one-bedroom apartment in downtown Stamford. The updated kitchen features new appliances, newer cabinetry, and countertops. Heat and hot water are included in the rent. Additional features include off-street parking in assigned space #170 and convenient in-building laundry. Enjoy everything downtown Stamford has to offer, all just moments from your door!
